brand.name: Zum Isaak

keep.why: Most-used chromatic cluster in the audit; the black wordmark and its layout stay unchanged.

axes.basis: measured: weighted mean hue 213° (cool), mean saturation 80% across 4 chromatic clusters; 8 neutral clusters.
axes.change: Swap the cool blue-grey neutrals for warm stone neutrals and keep one warm accent from the façade greens.

axes.basis: measured: 12 font families (3 system defaults, most used Font Awesome 5 Free), 16 distinct radii, 171 distinct colours.
axes.change: Cut to two type families and a small set of colours and radii, so each detail feels chosen rather than assembled.
Reduce to three shadow levels and drop most gradients so the photography carries the depth.

axes.basis: reading of copy: the copy is factual and calm (address, phone, opening hours 11:30-22:30) with a single welcome line.
axes.change: Keep the factual tone but add one warm, sensory sentence per section so information leads and welcome follows.

axes.basis: reading of copy: 'Herzlich willkommen', 'bietet allen einen Ort zum verweilen' and consistent use of Sie in the cookie notice.
axes.change: Keep the polite Sie register but soften headings and buttons with friendlier, everyday wording.

axes.basis: screenshot: serious layout with black buttons, plain serif-free headings and a formal cookie banner; no playful copy.
axes.change: Keep the composed tone but let one light, human touch appear in imagery and microcopy.

axes.basis: measured: 1688 visible characters per 1000 px of page height (4445 chars over 2633 px), body text 14 px.
axes.change: Increase section spacing and body size to 16 px so each block of text gets room to breathe.
